name: GitHub - New en.json keys to Slack
description: On a GitHub push touching any en.json in a QR-CODE-App repo (default branch), diffs the file before vs after and posts the new keys, the PR that added them and the Lokalise project link to #i18n-managment. Silent when no key was added.

parameters.url: =https://api.github.com/repos/{{ $('Normalize Push Event').item.json.owner }}/{{ $('Normalize Push Event').item.json.repo }}/contents/{{ $('Normalize Push Event').item.json.path }}?ref={{ $('Normalize Push Event').item.json.beforeSha }}

parameters.content:
## Works for every repo - no per-repo config

Any push that touches a file named en.json, on that repo default branch, is reported. New keys are the difference between the file before and after the push, flattened to Lokalise :: notation.

### Setup
1. GitHub PAT - a classic token with scope repo, added in n8n as a *GitHub API* credential and attached to both Fetch en.json nodes. The existing OAuth GitHub credential does NOT work: QR-CODE-App blocks OAuth apps (403, verified 26 Aug 2026).
2. ONE org-level webhook covers all repos: github.com/organizations/QR-CODE-App/settings/hooks - Payload URL = this workflow production webhook URL, content type application/json, event = Just the push event. Per-repo webhooks work too if org level is not possible.
3. Optional: LABELS in Normalize Push Event maps a repo name to a pretty product name. Unmapped repos are reported under their repo name.

Silent by design: pings, non-default branches, pushes that do not touch an en.json, and pushes that only change values produce no message. The reason is logged in the execution.

parameters.url: =https://api.github.com/repos/{{ $('Normalize Push Event').item.json.owner }}/{{ $('Normalize Push Event').item.json.repo }}/commits/{{ $('Normalize Push Event').item.json.afterSha }}/pulls
